locations: Met 1973.116: Andrea Schiavone (Andrea Meldola), The Marriage of Cupid and Psyche, ca.1540, oil on wood transferred to Masonite. In Apuleius' Golden Ass, Cupid and Psyche wed before Juno, Jupiter, Mars and the Olympians; originally octagonal, four corners later added, central Psyche myth ceiling at Castello di Salvatore di Collalto. Parmigianino influence; younger Tintoretto later influenced.
